messages:
omar: noticed a nasty one with the Ruby SDK and idempotency handling for indexing requests. REST accepts `Idempotency-Key` and server dedupes; Ruby SDK was lowercasing the header and our gateway treats it as distinct header -> double-indexing. Repro below.
tess: that's bad. do you have the raw requests?
omar: yep. curl (works, single index):
```bash
curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: idx-abc-123' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/indexing -d '{"doc_id":"d1","text":"hello"}'
```
-> single item indexed, 201.

omar: Ruby SDK (v0.9.2) sample causing duplicate entries:
```ruby
client.index.create(doc_id: 'd1', text: 'hello', idempotency_key: 'idx-abc-123')
# Observed: SDK sends header `idempotency-key: idx-abc-123` (lowercased) due to Faraday middleware; gateway normalizes header names differently and dedupe fails.
```

yuki: so middleware lowercases header keys. We normally rely on case-insensitive headers, but gateway checks canonical `Idempotency-Key` specifically? That sounds like a bug server-side.

omeghan: historically the gateway key check was case-insensitive, but a recent perf patch switched to a fast map lookup that uses the exact header name. We missed adding a canonicalization step. See RED-3505.

omar: yep. interim fixes: (1) patch Ruby SDK to set header with exact casing (workaround), (2) add gateway canonicalization patch. I'll do SDK patch and open a ticket for the gateway fix.

tess: also add an integration test that sends mixed-case headers and verifies dedupe. CI flaky tests were showing duplicate embeds in nightly for a while; this explains it.

ci-bot: created test failure ticket T-9123 for nightlies: duplicate indexing observed. Linked logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/idx-nightly/547.

yuki: small gotcha: some HTTP libs will canonicalize headers differently on different platforms (Ruby vs Node). We should add a doc in SDK guidelines saying: set Idempotency-Key header explicitly with that casing, and add server tolerant parsing.
omeghan: agree. I'll add a migration note in release notes for Ruby v0.9.3 and coordinate gateway fix. Plan: SDK hotfix v0.9.3 this afternoon, gateway patch in next deploy.

omar: PR incoming in ~2h. will include test and sampleapp fix (sampleapp was using Ruby snippet).
tess: thanks. follow-ups: (1) update onboarding docs to show header example, (2) run full parity job comparing raw headers across SDKs, (3) add lint to catch header lowercasing in Ruby middleware.
yuki: tagging @devex and @eng-runtime for visibility. Thanks all.
